FLAGSHIP PROJECT · HSE-01

Intune Baseline & Policy Conflict Engineering

Design Intune security baselines, investigate configuration conflicts and validate effective Windows controls.

PlannedNo HSE execution evidence yet
01

Security challenge

A configured policy does not prove that a control is enforced. Overlapping baselines and device profiles may apply conflicting values.

02

Proposed approach

Begin with a read-only inventory and competing hypotheses. Design a small pilot and introduce a single controlled change only after explicit approval.

03

Validation plan (not performed)

Positive test
A chosen security setting has the expected effective value, verified with independent device evidence.
Negative test
An excluded test group does not receive the control, or an original policy conflict is demonstrably explained.
Required evidence
Sanitized assignment matrix, before/after effective state, test log, verified rollback and residual risk.
04

Evidence boundaries

Earlier MD-102 conflict reports are learning context, not proof of completed HSE project work.

These are acceptance criteria, not observed test results.

CURRENT STATE

Planned · not started

PREREQUISITES

MD-102, Intune read access, a suitable test environment and separate approval for any changes.

PUBLICATION GATE

Private lab evidence requires human review and sanitization before public release.
